failures: P1: The published site still carries the template's demo persona — 'Ethan Callister. Photography fueled by passion for simplicity.' — on the home and about pages. Nothing warned at publish time that these are placeholder words.
P7: Not measured. Clicking an image did not open a viewer in our run, and we did not test a download or full-resolution link.
notes: Pixieset is not a prompt-first builder: the site comes from a template picker (we chose the portfolio theme Kyoto), so 'one prompt' does not apply. Account creation, email activation and publishing were automated; the activation link arrived in the same inbox we monitor for the site. Publishing was blocked until the account was activated — a real step a user hits too. The contact page has a working form with five fields; we did not submit it because that would send mail to the studio inbox. Images are the template's demo photos; uploading real photography is the one step we skipped, so P7 stays unmeasured rather than passed.
